reporting_policy.significant_figures: At least three significant figures where supported by sampling and calibration; extra digits are retained in CSV files for reproducibility, not as an uncertainty claim.
reporting_policy.uncertainty_policy: Use observed repeatability standard deviations when independent repeats exist. Treat curve-fit covariance as conditional fit-only uncertainty. Do not invent confidence levels or combine manufacturer specifications into a formal uncertainty budget without the missing calibration terms.

spatial_532_nm.attenuation: 1 inch Thorlabs reflective ND filters, used within rated range according to user
spatial_532_nm.primary_lobe_rule: highest-intensity spot is the intended beam

temporal_1064_nm.trigger_topology: Agilent 33120A output split by BNC T to GSL106A trigger input and scope CH3
temporal_1064_nm.scope_ch3_input: 1 Mohm according to exported setup metadata
temporal_1064_nm.mechanical_chopper_effect: present in some acquisitions for demonstration only; user reports it did not chop the laser
temporal_1064_nm.available_absolute_power_measurement: Average power measured with Thorlabs PM100D + S121C after the F280APC-1064 collimator and before attenuation: CW >16 mW; ps >1.35 uW; 1 ns >9.4 uW; 65 ns approximately 333 uW (observed 330-340 uW).
temporal_1064_nm.power_measurement_location: After F280APC-1064 collimator, before optical attenuation

spectral_532_and_1064_nm.detector: Synapse Plus CCD; exact detector variant not recorded
spectral_532_and_1064_nm.filename_slit_zero_meaning: fully closed or minimum slit separation; actual gap unknown

mercury_calibration.lines_used: 435.8 nm and 546.1 nm Hg lines; offsets manually adjusted until displayed peaks matched

unresolved_inputs: PDA36A responsivity at 1064 nm for the specific detector
Reflective ND transmission at 1064 nm for each temporal acquisition
Exact focusing-lens part number and orientation
Near-1064 nm wavelength reference or calibration residuals
Synapse Plus detector variant and response calibration
report_scope: Complete spatial, temporal, spectral, and power characterization using all supplied files.

1064_nm.delivery: Fiber output followed by F280APC-1064 free-space collimator

spatial_setup.automatic_controls: Auto gain, auto exposure, and color correction disabled
spatial_setup.attenuation: Thorlabs 1 inch reflective ND filters, used within range
spatial_setup.optical_path: Laser -> reflective ND filter(s) -> one mirror -> camera
spatial_setup.z_convention: Positive z is farther from the source/lens
spatial_setup.focusing_lens: Thorlabs plano-convex lens, approximately 100 mm focal length

temporal_setup.trigger_connection: Function generator output split by BNC T to GSL106A trigger input and oscilloscope CH3
temporal_setup.termination_interpretation: No separate external terminator; records labeled 50 ohm use oscilloscope input termination.
temporal_setup.mechanical_chopper: Present at 987 Hz for demonstration only; not intercepting/modulating the analyzed beam

spectral_setup.slits: Fully closed or minimum practical separation unless filename states otherwise

wavelength_calibration.method: Grating-specific wavelength offsets adjusted until the two visible peaks matched to four significant figures
wavelength_calibration.consequence: Absolute wavelength accuracy near 1064 nm is unverified; measured widths remain more robust than absolute centers.

power_measurement.location: Free-space output immediately after the F280APC-1064 collimator for the GSL106A; before any attenuation
power_measurement.uncertainty_policy: No arbitrary combined uncertainty is assigned without the sensor calibration certificate, repeated readings, and environmental/geometry records.
